summary: Re-review after revise: synchronous resend under supervisor mu, relevo test drains c1, docs and log fixed; contract ok, 11/11 on 27749a2, M1/M5 reproduced red. Approve.

FINDING 1 (previous, non-atomic snapshot+enqueue) FIXED: sidecar/internal/servidor/manejo.go step 5 now calls s.fuenteDeEstado with a closure that encodes AND calls nueva.enviar(frame) inside entregar, i.e. under the supervisor mu held by ConUltimoEstado (reconexion.go, defer Unlock). Reviewer reproduced mutation M5 (keep the encode inside entregar, move nueva.enviar after the source returns) on a scratch clone: diff non-empty, go test ./internal/servidor red ONLY on TestEmisionTrasLaInstantaneaQuedaUltimaEnElCable ('orden roto: ... llegó activa'), all other tests green; so the atomicity guard is real and specific.

FINDING 2 (previous, goroutine + 10 ms sleep + TOCTOU) FIXED: no goroutine, no time.Sleep, no s.actual == check remain in manejo.go; the resend runs synchronously after nueva.conn.Write(saludo) and after s.actual = nueva (set at step 2 under s.mu, released before step 5). TestRelevoDeConexionReenviaElUltimoEstadoALaNueva now reads greeting + resent state on c1, then drains c1 under its read deadline admitting only identical estado_sesion frames until EOF, then asserts c2's greeting + resend. Reviewer mutation M1 (nueva.enviar(frame) replaced by discard) red on TestReenvioDeEstadoPausadaConservaLosCuatroCampos, TestRelevoDeConexionReenviaElUltimoEstadoALaNueva, TestFuenteDeEstadoConSupervisorRealReenviaActivaAlConectar and TestEmisionTrasLaInstantaneaQuedaUltimaEnElCable; the new Go tests plus TestTakeoverConexionMasRecienteGana and both ConUltimoEstado unit tests pass -race -count=20 on the clone.

Lock-order analysis (orchestrator question): atenderConexion holds s.mu only for the s.cerrado/s.actual swap (manejo.go step 2) and releases it before calling the source, so the server lock is never held while the supervisor mu is taken. The established order is supervisor.mu -> servidor.mu(RLock) (emitirEstado -> sumidero -> EnviarEstadoSesion); the new path takes supervisor.mu -> conexionActiva.enviar, which is a select on c.cerrada / c.saliente with no lock at all. escribirSaliente and cerrar take no supervisor mu, Cerrar takes s.mu then act.cerrar (no supervisor mu). No cycle. enviar under the supervisor mu can block only with the 100-slot queue full and the connection neither drained nor closed, the same pre-existing property of emitirEstado; on takeover anterior.cerrar closes c.cerrada so a blocked enviar on the old connection returns. A single duplicate delivery of an emission landing between s.actual = nueva and the snapshot is idempotent for the Rust watch (blueprint risk note).

FINDING 3 (previous, docs describing the timer) FIXED: docs/STATUS.md appended sentence and docs/plan/fase-a-6-empaquetado-cli.md closing note now describe the synchronous resend under the supervisor mu on the already-current connection; only exact literals added by HEX-094 were replaced (main...HEAD still shows pure appends on the two Pendiente lines, the new Pendiente at the end, and the plan note); guarda-hex-094.sh OK and --autoprueba 28/28 per 05-validation.
